description: A synthetic plane source of 14.1 MeV neutrons, isotropic, uniformly distributed over the slab face, emitting into the shield with a vacuum behind it. The area is the slab's lateral extent; the strength is a small deuterium-tritium generator's order of magnitude.
dose_coefficient_note: Approximate ambient dose equivalent per unit fluence at 14 MeV for the screening step only; the transport step uses the ICRP-116 anterior-posterior coefficients shipped with OpenMC over the full transmitted spectrum.
